title: Lineage insight submission
description: The payload contract for reporting model-composition facts to a Lineage registry (§11.6.1). Versioned independently of the API: a producer sends `schemaVersion` and the registry rejects a version it does not speak, rather than partially applying the write. Unknown fields are rejected, not dropped, so a producer can tell it is talking to an older registry.

schemaVersion.description: The contract this payload is written against.

source.description: How this producer obtained the facts in this write. Stamped onto every field the write touches.

reporter.description: The tool submitting this record, e.g. 'lineage-scanner'. Distinct from facts.producer, which is the library that wrote the model files.

facts.description: Mergeable fields. On PATCH an absent key is left unchanged and an explicit null clears; `hashes` and `coverage` merge per sub-key. On PUT the document is replaced.

framework.description: Runtime the model targets, e.g. pytorch / 2.4.1.

producer.description: Library that wrote the files, e.g. transformers / 4.44.

paramCountMethod.description: The methods disagree under tied embeddings and sharded checkpoints, so the record states which was used.

quantMethod.description: e.g. gptq, awq, bnb-nf4, Q4_K_M, ptq-static. Null means not quantized. This is a declared value: hashes cannot distinguish quantization from retraining (§11.4.4).

quantScope.description: Which modules were quantized or held out at higher precision.

weightsBytes.description: Sum of tensor nbytes. Differs from diskBytes under sharding, zip, or compression — do not conflate them.

coverage.description: Per field, why a value was or was not supplied. Distinguishes 'the format does not expose this' from 'not attempted' — an unfilled field must never be reported as zero.

layers.description: The layer breakdown, collapsed over repeats. Absent leaves the recorded set alone; an explicit (even empty) array replaces the whole set, since a list has no meaningful per-element merge.

factSource.description: declared = asserted by a human or CI, attributed but not verified. derived = computed by a producer from the model itself. measured = observed by a runtime or harness, valid only within its stated basis.

nullableCount.description: Null means not reported. Never send 0 for an unknown value.

hashes.description: The four-level architecture fingerprint (§11.4), computed over the canonical arch doc. Levels are separable so the diff verdict is a table lookup rather than a heuristic; submit whatever you can compute. Merges per sub-key, so a header-only scanner may send the first three and the SDK add `weights` later.

topology.description: Ordered op graph: op types, connectivity, and non-weight attributes (num_heads, kernel, stride, activation, norm placement). Excludes shapes, dtypes, weights.

shape.description: Topology plus every tensor shape. Excludes dtypes and weights.

dtype.description: The per-tensor dtype vector. Excludes weights.

weights.description: Merkle root over per-tensor content digests, sorted by name. Compute it while the artifact is already streaming at publish, never by re-downloading. Omitting it narrows the diff verdict rather than breaking it.

archDoc.description: The canonical normalized graph summary the hashes were computed over. Producers may carry any additional keys; the registry reads only `tensors`, for the per-tensor partial diff. See the normalization rules in docs/11 §4.5 — two producers must agree on them or their hashes will not match.

digest.description: Content digest of this tensor's bytes, e.g. sha256:… Retaining these is what lets a diff say 'only q_proj and lm_head changed' — a merged LoRA adapter rather than a full fine-tune.

layerBlock.description: One distinct block, collapsed over repeats. An 80-layer decoder contributes one entry per distinct sub-module with repeatCount 80, not eighty copies.

path.description: Dotted path with '*' for the repeated block index, e.g. model.layers.*.self_attn.q_proj

paramCount.description: Per single instance; multiply by repeatCount for the rollup.

ordinal.description: Ignored on write; assigned by position.
